input.description: Find resolveCategory usage in expenses page

content.text:
I've reviewed the diffs. These are predominantly clean singleton→DI refactors and extract-method refactors (ReconciliationService, ReceiptService, PDFExportService, ExpenseService) that preserve the original algorithms — the pre-existing O(R×T) matching double-scan in ReconciliationService and the sequential PDF image fetches are unchanged by the diff, so I'm not flagging them. I found one clearly-introduced efficiency regression.

```json
[
  {
    "file": "src/routes/expenses/+page.svelte",
    "line": 1144,
    "summary": "categoryCell snippet now calls resolveCategory(expense, categories) per rendered row, which does an Array.find() over the categories list. The old code built the Category object directly from the row's denormalized category_id/category_name/category_color fields with no lookup.",
    "failure_scenario": "The DataTable renders categoryCell once per visible expense row (rows = filteredExpenses). resolveCategory() runs `categories.find(c => c.id === row.category_id)`, so each render is O(rows x categories) linear scans that did not exist before (the prior path was O(1) per row). This re-runs on every reactive re-render of the table (e.g. selecting a row, toggling a filter, editing). Cheaper alternative: the repo already ships buildCategoryMap() in $lib/utils/resolveCategory (used by the receipts/reconciliation pages); build a $derived Map<category_id, Category> once and look it up in the cell, or keep using the row's denormalized fields directly."
  }
]
```

Notes on items I checked and deliberately did not flag as regressions:
- ReconciliationService `performMatching` refactor: the redundant `findPotentialMatches` recomputation for unmatched receipts and the O(R×T)/O(T×R) scans all existed in the original; the extract-method split is efficiency-neutral.
- receipts/reconciliation `buildCategoryMap(expenses, categories)`: replaces a hand-rolled loop that already did `categories.find` per expense — same cost, not a regression.
- PDFExportService `drawReceiptImagePages` adds one `Object.values(groups).flat()` pass to count images; O(n) allocation once per export, negligible against image fetching.
- transactions page switched `deleting` to `SvelteSet` and dropped the `deleting = new Set(deleting)` reassignments — an improvement, not a regression.
- expenses page `pdfExportEnabled = $derived(...)` replaces two inline `shouldEnablePDFExport({...})` calls per render (disabled binding + handler) with one memoized computation — an improvement.
